from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiability(BaseModel):
    """Total liability figure from one company's financial filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    liability_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g., 'Total Liabilities', 'Expense Reserve under liabilities')")
    liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The liability amount as reported in the statement")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount: 'thousands', 'dollars', 'millions', etc.")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the liability figure is from, e.g., 'March 31, 2024'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the filing showing the liability figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liabilities: list[CompanyLiability]
